episodes.synopsis: The mischievous students of Arama Academy meet their match in a beautiful and clever new teacher, Miss Machiko! But they're determined to find a prank that will really humiliate her...
episodes.title: Pranks? I Give Up!

episodes.synopsis: Kenta's late-night skateboarding lessons have him falling asleep in class. What will Machiko do when she gets her hands on the board?
episodes.title: Kenta's Skateboard Plan

episodes.synopsis: Kame's over the moon for a popular idol! When Machiko tries to cure him of it, she ends up with an idol debut of her own!
episodes.title: Go After the Idol!

episodes.synopsis: When a gang from a rival academy starts trouble with Arama's students, Machiko won't stand for it! They'll have to settle their differences... with mud wrestling?!
episodes.title: Clash! The Bicycle Army!

episodes.synopsis: Class bookworm Hiroshi doesn't like exercise or socializing. Machiko arranges a class outing to cure him of his single-minded nature, but will her plan work too well?
episodes.title: I'll Touch the Teacher, Too!

episodes.synopsis: Machiko tries to help Shizuo, who is staying home to take care of his brothers, a trio of mischievous toddlers. But when they bring them to school, all hell breaks loose!
episodes.title: Hands Up! The Baby Gang

episodes.synopsis: Kinzo is obsessed with bad-boy rock trio Yokohama Ginrrow. Machiko encourages him to follow his dream... by having the whole class mimic the band at the school festival!
episodes.title: The Rockin' School Festival

episodes.synopsis: Kenta's latest obsession is the Frisbee, and everything he can do with it... ripping blouses, flipping skirts, and stealing underwear! Can Machiko learn the skills to put the "Frisbee Angel" in his place?
episodes.title: Great Victory with a Hidden Camera

episodes.synopsis: A groper on a crowded bus is preying on the women and girls of Arama Academy. Kenta takes exception to this cowardly behavior, and vows to catch the culprit!
episodes.title: Get the Groper!

episodes.synopsis: Mr. Yamagata decides that hypnotism is his only way to win Machiko's heart. But her fantasy life turns out to be a little different from what he expects...
episodes.title: Mixed Up Hypnotism

episodes.synopsis: The Bicycle Army are back, and this time, they're framing Kinzo for shoplifting! Can Machiko and Kenta unite to end Genkichi's bullying once more?
episodes.title: New Weapon: The Whoopee Panties

episodes.synopsis: Machiko's class decides to help a lonely little girl celebrate Christmas. But the good times are cut short when a thief steals her dog!
episodes.title: A Surprising Present from Santa

episodes.synopsis: After getting drunk at a New Year's party, Kenta dreams he's taken a time machine to the future... where he's a handsome adult, and dating Miss Machiko!
episodes.title: The Time Machine of Love

episodes.synopsis: An overnight trip to a skating rink becomes a nightmare when the class funds are stolen. And it's even worse for Yamagata when a handsome stranger begins flirting with Machiko!
episodes.title: The Skating, Falling Roundup

episodes.synopsis: The girls decide they've had enough of the boys' lecherous ways. But can they keep Kenta from playing pranks on Miss Machiko, even for one day?
episodes.title: Break Through the Booby Guard

episodes.synopsis: When a spoiled rich kid offers marriage to Machiko, Mr. Yamagata and Nabe counter with proposals of their own! Can the class help Machiko shake off all three unwanted suitors?
episodes.title: A Proposal for Princess Kaguya

episodes.synopsis: A kidnapper mistakes Miss Machiko for a rich heiress, and tries to hold her ransom! But it seems there's more to him than meets the eye...
episodes.title: Two Miss Machikos

episodes.synopsis: Mr. Yamagata's insistence that Machiko gave him Valentine's Day chocolates leads him to clash with another of her unwanted suitors.
episodes.title: Valentine's Duel

episodes.synopsis: Kenta and Kame have tried everything in the book to restore confidence to their depressed friend, Kinzo. The only thing left to try is... a wrestling match!
episodes.title: The Match! Team Machiko vs. Team Kenta

episodes.synopsis: A runaway elephant and an injured trapeze artist lead to Machiko's entire class taking part in the circus!
episodes.title: The Circus is Here

episodes.synopsis: The whole school has come together to celebrate Miss Machiko's birthday. Yamagata is determined to use the occasion to prove that he and Machiko are the perfect couple... and hires a matchmaking robot for the task!
episodes.title: The Microprocessor Birthday

episodes.synopsis: When a UFO descends on the town, Madoka and Yamagata gain psychic powers! Madoka uses hers to defend her friends and fight for justice... while Yamagata uses his to spy on Machiko in the bath!
episodes.title: A Present from Space

episodes.synopsis: When a beautiful blonde from America refuses Kenta's advances, Kenta becomes even more determined to get his feelings through... and what better way than a boys-versus-girls sumo tournament?
episodes.title: The Blue-Eyed Rival

episodes.synopsis: Dr. Aomori has arranged a golf tournament with a new video recorder as the prize. Kenta, Kame, and Kinzo are determined to help Machiko win it by any means necessary!
episodes.title: Swing with the Hips, One, Two, Three!

episodes.synopsis: Miss Machiko takes a brooding Hiroshi along to a girls-only tennis camp to try to cheer him up. Of course, Kenta's not going to let him be the only boy there...
episodes.title: Spring Vacation in Peril!

episodes.synopsis: Reports of an ancient dinosaur in a local lake bring Machiko and her students to investigate!
episodes.title: Find the Monster, Nassie!

episodes.synopsis: When a new ramen shop starts offering a trip to Hawaii, Nabe's business is in trouble! Of course, Kenta has new a plan to round up customers...
episodes.title: The One-Touch Ramen of Love

episodes.synopsis: Mr. Yamagata overhears Miss Machiko talking about how she wants to quit school. Will quitting in solidarity lead to her love... or backfire spectacularly?
episodes.title: Two Touches and a Misunderstanding

episodes.synopsis: A naughty neighborhood crow is stealing Miss Machiko's panties, and it's up to her and the boys to get them back!
episodes.title: The Crow Does What He Wants

episodes.synopsis: Kenta's job at a local amusement park is threatened when Genkichi's dad decides to buy the place and tear it down! Can he cook up a prank smart enough to save the children's paradise?
episodes.title: The See-Saw Battle Decided by Boobs

episodes.synopsis: A crash landing on a bountiful tropical island should be paradise for Kenta and his class... until they're interrupted by a tyrannical holdover from the war!
episodes.title: SOS! The Blue Lagoon

episodes.synopsis: A pro wrestling manager scouts Kinzo for the big leagues... but it all turns out to be a gimmick for a match with a beautiful lady wrestler!
episodes.title: The Boobie Tap Out

episodes.synopsis: Kenta causes trouble all around the school when he decides to play reporter... by breaking news on Machiko's private life!
episodes.title: Kenta the Action Reporter

episodes.synopsis: When Kenta, Kame, and Kinzo break a valuable vase, Miss Machiko decides to take part in a beauty contest to help them pay back their debt!
episodes.title: Take on the Beauty Contest

episodes.synopsis: When a troubled new student comes to the school, Miss Machiko will do anything to help fix his family situation. But will that include dressing as a geisha to turn his father around?
episodes.title: Teacher's Hips Have 100 Horsepower

episodes.synopsis: Kenta ends up playing a role in a period drama on TV. But a serious injury on set leads to Miss Machiko playing the lead!
episodes.title: Marshmallow White Knight Tengu

episodes.synopsis: Mr. Yamagata leads a field trip to a farm, where he ends up in a rivalry with a handsome college friend of Miss Machiko.
episodes.title: The Field Planting Field Trip

episodes.synopsis: A speaker comes to Arama Academy, stirring up dissent between the boys and the girls! Can Miss Machiko get them to work out their differences before tragedy strikes?
episodes.title: The Peace a Baby Brings

episodes.synopsis: On the eve of Tanibata, Kenta tries to help Kameyama confess his love to the girl of his dreams. But when he sees her going out with another man...
episodes.title: The July 7th Rendezvous

episodes.synopsis: Machiko's class takes a field trip to the ocean, and ends up saving a dolphin from a net! But will the locals hunt the dolphin down before they can get it to safety?
episodes.title: The Dolphin Returns

episodes.synopsis: The town's annual bicycle race is thrown into chaos by Genkichi's grandmother, who is willing to do anything to see that her grandson takes the trophy!
episodes.title: The Mean-Spirited Bicycle Race

episodes.synopsis: Madoka learns that her college-aged crush is slipping into a life of delinquency, and she heads to the wrong side of the tracks to try to help him. Can Machiko and the others save Madoka before she gets in over her head?
episodes.title: Madoka's Prince

episodes.synopsis: When an innocent prank on Parents' Day ends up causing a riot, Hiroshi's outraged mother threatens to pull him out of school! Can Kenta and the others find a way to get him back... before Miss Machiko quits as well?!
episodes.title: Parents' Day Run Amok

episodes.synopsis: Machiko, Kenta, and his friends are spending summer vacation doing good deeds for the elderly. But their courage is put to the test when their next client turns out to be a creepy doctor living in a haunted house!
episodes.title: Dr. Dracula's Laboratory

episodes.synopsis: Kenta, Kinzo, and Kame learn the secret to Mr. Yamagata's amazing memory... self-hypnosis! But when they try it themselves to improve their test scores, things quickly start spiraling out of control...
episodes.title: The Boy Geniuses

episodes.synopsis: Kenta's mischief ruins the town's chance to get a popular singer to help with the anniversary festival! Can Miss Machiko find a way to set things right?
episodes.title: A Happy Dance to Festival Music

episodes.synopsis: Miss Machiko, Kenta, and the others are performing on a late-night radio show, when they receive a call from a little girl in need...
episodes.title: Call Us to Save Your Life

episodes.synopsis: To keep Miss Machiko away from a handsome new suitor, Mr. Yamagata cooks up a wild story about aliens.
episodes.title: The Comeback Macchi Smash

episodes.synopsis: All the cool kids want to join in with the latest craze, the Takenoko Dance! Kenta fosters a rivalry with a cocky young star who turns out to be more than meets the eye...
episodes.title: Banzai, Takenoko Dancers!

episodes.synopsis: Hiroshi is hired to tutor a spoiled rich young man. But when his so-called pupil makes life hell for him, can Kenta step in to make things right?
episodes.title: Kenta the Home Tutor

episodes.synopsis: Sports Day has arrived, and Kenta hopes to be paired up with Miss Machiko... but he's paired up with Maruko instead! Can Kenta find a way out of the arrangement and still win the individual award?
episodes.title: The Enthusiastic Three-Legged Race

episodes.synopsis: Mr. Fukuoka is saying goodbye to Arama Academy to return to his home town. But Miss Machiko misunderstands and thinks he's moving to Paris!
episodes.title: The Hip Line of My Memories

episodes.synopsis: When a Moai statue inexplicably ends up on Arama Academy's doorstep, the faculty become convinced that only a sacred ritual can send it home. And the only one who can perform it is... Mr. Yamagata?!
episodes.title: The Messenger from Easter Island

episodes.synopsis: To cheer the girls up after an awful day of pranking, Miss Machiko tells them a story about her own youth. As it happens, she once knew a mischievous little boy who was a lot like Kenta...
episodes.title: The Red-Haired Board

episodes.synopsis: An archaeological excursion into the mountain behind Arama Academy yields a remarkable discovery: a mural depicting the ancestors of Mr. Yamagata and Miss Machiko!
episodes.title: A New Discovery: The Primitive Yamagata

episodes.synopsis: A new art teacher arrives, triggering Mr. Yamagata's jealousy. Can he impress Miss Machiko with his photography skills?
episodes.title: A Chance for Photographic Love

episodes.synopsis: Miss Machiko falls for a handsome kung fu dojo. But Bruce has a dark secret he won't admit to anyone...
episodes.title: Kung-Fu Lady Number One

episodes.synopsis: The class gets a pretty new exchange student named Sayuri. She's trying to hide the fact that her family are ninjas, but Kenta's pranks won't make it easy!
episodes.title: Sayuri the Ninja

episodes.synopsis: When the king of an island nation arrives in Arama for a friendship visit, he falls head over heels for Miss Machiko!
episodes.title: The Love Call from the South Seas

episodes.synopsis: Mr. Yamagata's grandmother is visiting... and she thinks he's engaged to Machiko! Will Machiko keep up the charade to protect her colleague's dignity?
episodes.title: The Lovey-Dovey Honeymoon

episodes.synopsis: When Kenta plays fortune-teller at a festival, he ends up filling Mr. Yamagata's head with crazy ideas... including one about an impending alien invasion?!
episodes.title: Kenta's Big Shocking Prediction

episodes.synopsis: What starts as class trip to a voice actor recording studio ends with Miss Machiko voicing the lead in a hot new robot anime!
episodes.title: The Big Boobie Bail-Out

episodes.synopsis: Hiroshi's health is failing, and he needs exercise! Miss Machiko offers to help, but of course, Mr. Yamagata won't be left out...
episodes.title: Healthy Jogging in a Straight Line

episodes.synopsis: Machiko and the girls are invited to stay at a ski resort run by Kinzo's uncle. But a reckless dare threatens to turn their holiday into a tragedy!
episodes.title: The Straight Ski from the Hips

episodes.synopsis: Maruko is set to play Santa at the school Christmas party, but when the time comes, she never arrives. What's happened to Maruko, and does it have something to do with the bully Genkichi?
episodes.title: The Kiss-Kiss Christmas Cake

episodes.synopsis: When a woman abandons her child, Machiko takes the girl in while they search the mother. But when a trip to the zoo goes awry...
episodes.title: Machiko the Lion-Tamer

episodes.synopsis: Mr. Yamagata is desperate to try a new plant that is rumored to give people longer legs. But when he finally gets his hands on it, things start to get strange...
episodes.title: The Secret of Longleg Weed

episodes.synopsis: Arama Topics is looking for new submissions. While the boys try to do an in-depth article on Miss Machiko, the girls attempt to learn Mr. Kagoshima's secrets!
episodes.title: The Secrets of Beauty and Popularity

episodes.synopsis: Kenta and the gang have gone wild about painting the clay models sold by a local vendor. But when the vice principal forbids the hobby, they find a new outlet for their creativity.
episodes.title: The Boobie Baking Powder

episodes.synopsis: Kinzo's trained homing pigeons end up coming in handy when he gets mixed up in a kidnapping!
episodes.title: The Homing Pigeon Rescue Squad

episodes.synopsis: A trip into the mountains for Setsubun (the first day of spring) gets a little out of control when the boys run off ahead, and spot an oni!
episodes.title: Red Oni, Blue Oni, Family Oni

episodes.synopsis: Miss Machiko saves the life of a popular manga artist who's running desperately low on ideas. Will she and her class be able to pull him out of the dumps?
episodes.title: Great Job, Manga Artist

episodes.synopsis: When Kame learns sewing to help his family with their new cleaning business the other boys tease him relentlessly. Can Machiko find a way to smooth things over?
episodes.title: The Friendly Needlework Class

episodes.synopsis: A traveling salesman visits Arama... and he might just put down roots for Machiko!
episodes.title: The Travels of Jirocho

episodes.synopsis: A series of strange pranks leads Miss Machiko to encourage the boys and girls to work together on a Girls' Day project.
episodes.title: To Whom Goes the Empress?

episodes.synopsis: Miss Machiko encourages the boys befriend a lonely elementary schooler. Kenta isn't interested... until he learns that the boy will pay him!
episodes.title: The Powerful Rival Trio

episodes.synopsis: The principal leads a trip to the mountains to catch a legendary fish. But will a supernatural threat keep him from his glory?
episodes.title: The Guardian Tengu

episodes.synopsis: Kenta goes to a local shrine to pray for Miss Machiko to recover from a cold, but an encounter with a yukionna gives him much more than he bargained for.
episodes.title: Achoo! A Spring Cold!

episodes.synopsis: Maruko's ambiguously-labeled birthday gift to Kenta kicks off a chain of misunderstandings.
episodes.title: Kenta's Unbelievable Birthday

episodes.synopsis: Miss Machiko takes on the duties of policewoman for a day. But her usually no-nonsense partner's mind is focused on more romantic troubles...
episodes.title: The Boobie Patrol

episodes.synopsis: Fed up with the behavior of Arama's students, Vice Principal Aichi considers a lucrative offer from a fancier school.
episodes.title: The Vice Principal's Big Decision

episodes.synopsis: Miss Machiko gets scouted by a world-class fashion designer. Fearing that she might leave for good, Kenta decides to prank the fashion show.
episodes.title: The Mysterious Super Dress

episodes.synopsis: Can children be satisfied with old-fashioned entertainment? Machiko hopes so, when she agrees to help a humble puppeteer put on his show.
episodes.title: The Magic Puppet Show

episodes.synopsis: It's Children's Day, and Kenta urges Machiko to create some koinobori banners. Of course, his secret motive is to climb inside one and spy on the bath!
episodes.title: The May 5th Ambush

episodes.synopsis: Annoyed at Kenta's constant harassment of the girls, the vice principal decides to nip things in the bud... by banning skirts from school.
episodes.title: The Skirt Prohibition

episodes.synopsis: An encounter with a master prognosticator leads Miss Machiko to have disastrous visions of the future.
episodes.title: The Psychic Present

episodes.synopsis: Miss Machiko is looking forlorn, and the students assume she's fallen in love. But as they follow her around for the day, they realize the truth is far bleaker.
episodes.title: The Terrible Love Misconception

episodes.synopsis: A class visit to a science expo turns into a mad chase when a con man steals the students' bags... and their clothes!
episodes.title: The Great Pursuit Through Wonderland

episodes.synopsis: Miss Machiko and the boys visit a school in Hawaii. Can Kenta and the others survive a turning of the tables by the brash Hawaiian girls?!
episodes.title: Aloha with a Touch

episodes.synopsis: The boys build a variety of pedal-powered flying machines, one of which takes Machiko and Kenta on a death-defying journey.
episodes.title: The Exhausting Man-Powered Flight

episodes.synopsis: On hearing that her father's been in an accident, Machiko rushes home to Kyoto. But it all turns out to be a trick to get her engaged to a local man!
episodes.title: The Troubling Trip Home

episodes.synopsis: A "Cinderella Story" search breaks out when Machiko proves the only perfect fit for a famous Parisian designer's bra.
episodes.title: Beloved Machiko Goes to Paris

episodes.synopsis: When Kenta and friends accidentally take out the local ramen delivery boy with their remote-control planes, Machiko decides to take over his duties.
episodes.title: The Great Remote Control Flight

episodes.synopsis: The girls spearhead a trip to Maruko's relatives in the country, where a local legend says the tea can make girls bustier.
episodes.title: The Angel Who Lost Her Robe

episodes.synopsis: Arama Academy's 80th anniversary celebration is threatened when the vice principal's hard-nosed niece transfers to the school.
episodes.title: The Soft Touch of Love
